name: Aminatou's Augury
oracle_text: Exile the top eight cards of your library. You may put a land card from among them onto the battlefield. Until end of turn, for each nonland card type, you may cast a spell of that type from among the exiled cards without paying its mana cost.
blocked_sentences: Until end of turn, for each nonland card type, you may cast a spell of that type from among the exiled cards without paying its mana cost.

needs.what: a playable-from-exile free-cast permission (on exile / look_at_top / grant_playable) capped at one spell per nonland card type for the turn: the permission ledger tracks which of Artifact, Battle, Creature, Enchantment, Instant, Kindred, Planeswalker and Sorcery have been used, and a spell with several card types (an artifact creature) is cast as one chosen unused type, consuming only that one
needs.why_existing_wont_do: exile/look_at_top carry playable_this_turn + playable_free, which would let every exiled nonland card be cast free (strictly better than printed); grant_playable's `limit` is a single per-source count ('a spell', Locke), stored as playable_group = source, with no notion of per-card-type buckets, so it would cap the whole grant at N spells regardless of type
